item.title: Ai+ Pulse 2 Price in India, Specifications and Features
item.description: Ai+ has launched the Pulse 2 smartphone in India, featuring a 120Hz HD+ display and a 6,000mAh battery. item.title: Holi in Pakistan: Hindu Community To Celebrate Holi With Simplicity Following President Asif Ali Zardari’s Appeal Over Situation in Gulf
item.description: Following President Asif Ali Zardari’s appeal, Pakistan's Hindu community will celebrate Holi (March 4) with simplicity. Dr Ramesh Kumar Vankwani of the Pakistan Hindu Council cited regional instability and the Iran-Israel conflict as reasons to avoid large gatherings, prioritising national security and citizen safety.
